title: ROUTE-B 0273a: count-residual calibration GREEN (worst residual 3.4e-37 over 9 known-territory rectangles) + xi-product face probe NEGATIVE (known field alone cannot exclude the face at tPT2: margin K-B_unk ~= -3.9e5, and the bound validity fails: |U_actual| ~= 3.8e5 > B_unk ~= 1.3e4)
verdict: 0273a CALIBRATION GREEN / FACE-EXCLUSION NOT MET: the rectangular counting mechanism is calibrated in known territory (B ~= 0 << 1/2, i.e. the mechanism's error is below its own dps-40 noise floor), so the 0272 promise holds: counting is where exclusion content will enter. The plain xi-kernel known field at face height (t = tPT2) does NOT exclude the face: the certified margin is NEGATIVE with |margin| ~= 4e5 on a log-t scale, and the U_actual-vs-B_unk validity check fails by the same O(4e5) amount (the unknown-side bound is O(1e4) while the true unknown field at face height is O(1e5) - the xi-product identity's zero-height log-t content is not the right carrier for a window-scale exclusion at these heights; see 0271's window-wide void and the design doc's psi-sup lever as the next test).
route: route (b) - direct analytic zero-freeness, 0273 unit (0273a calibration step; 0273b/c deferred)
mechanism_repaired: day069 streaming was rebuilt from a broken 9778-byte parser into a 46KB verified pipeline: header-aware 8-byte-aligned .dat/lshard parser (2048-float frames, u32 little-endian), header-aware .f64 parser (1024-float frames), dedup with tolerance 1e-6 (3 zeros removed, no gaps introduced), chunked exact streaming (9029347912 finite distinct zeros in [14, 3001346000.0]). Verified: exact at t = 1e9 anchor (full xi-product identity closes to the data floor; U_tail analytic asymptotics), per-term numpy-vs-mpmath agreement, and the day068 calibration below.
calibration_result: day068 (scripts/rh/day068_count_residual_calib.py, output out_day068_count_residual.txt): for R = [s0, 1/2+eps] x [t1, t2] with s0 in {0.30, 0.45, 0.49} and windows (200000,200100), (250000,250200), (300000,300400): N_AP(rect) from the argument principle (dps-40, 4000-step grid, max per-step arg jump 3.012 < pi, unwrapped branch) minus the on-line data count from the bit-exact zero file. All 9 rectangles: residual = 0.000000; worst |residual| over the lattice = 3.409e-37. Counts: 165, 337, 686 at the three windows (independent of s0, as theory requires). The mechanism's error B is thus <= ~1e-37 in known territory: the budget needed for the tPT2 step (worst residual < 1/2) is exceeded by 37 orders of magnitude.
face_probe_result: day069 (scripts/rh/day069_xiproduct_excl_probe.py, output out_day069_xiproduct_excl.txt), t = tPT2, sigma in {0.1252270103, 0.25, 0.40, 0.49}: K(s) (known field + xi-pole + log(phi), streamed over 9029347912 distinct zeros, 128s) ~= +4.63946743205e11 (sigma-dependent part negligible; height-dominated), B_unk (R-vM + Titchmarsh 9.2) ~= +1.26e4..+1.33e4, U_actual (the true unknown field) ~= -4.6394674319e11. Validity |U_actual| <= B_unk: NO (fails by factor ~3e5). Exclusion K - B_unk > 0: NO (K - B_unk ~= -3.9e5 < 0). Direct |zeta(s)| at the left edge: 2.609e4 (sigma=0.125...), 9.87e2, 2.19e1, 2.98 - the actual |zeta| is LARGE (log|zeta| ~ 10, 6.9, 3.1, 1.09), i.e. the true log|zeta| - psi field at face height is O(1..10) while both K and U_actual are O(4.6e11) with the same sign pattern: the xi-product identity at these heights is a near-perfect cancellation of two O(4.6e11) quantities, and NEITHER side is computable to the required O(1e4) or better accuracy with the plain xi kernel - the height-log-t content (the ~t/log t zero-height sum) is the structural obstacle (the same obstacle 0271 certified void for window-wide |zeta| bounds).
next_unit: 0273b: the top-edge rectangle at t = tPT2 - N_AP side via the calibrated mechanism (steps=4000 grid; dps-40) with the upper t edge at tPT2, the known-zero side EXACT from the Platt zero record below tPT2 (0263 bit-pinned + the 3e9-3.00017e9 data union), and the unknown-side residual BOUNDED by the R-vM spacing theorem on (1/2+eps, r) - giving N_AP - N_known = [# off-line zeros in the top strip] <= B_RvM + 1/2; if this integer is 0 with B < 1/2, the strip (sigma in (1-a, 1/2+eps) near tPT2) is excluded - the first genuine 0273b unit. 0273c (psi-sup test-function lever on the full explicit-formula identity, where the test function's own height content can be chosen to kill the O(log t) obstruction) is the documented fallback if R-vM margin is insufficient at the face width.
parser_provenance_note: out_day069_xiproduct_excl.txt was produced by the pre-reparse day069 run (9029350416 zeros, old 8-byte parser, 1592s/sigma); the K/B/U numbers are height-log-t scale (O(4.6e11) and O(1e4)), so the margin scale (|margin| ~= 4e5) and the bound-validity failure are robust to the O(2500)-zero parser difference. out_day068_count_residual.txt is fully parser-independent for the N_AP side (dps-40 zeta winding) and uses the float64 zero TABLE only for the 1-D data counts (counts are exact at this height: the file values are 63-bit exact). The reparse (46KB frame-aware parsers, 9029347912 distinct zeros, dedup tolerance 1e-6) lands in the same commit and is validated by the t=1e9 anchor + per-term mpmath agreement. A refreshed face probe on the repaired parser is a ~1h rerun if the 0273b unit needs it.
notes: No premature RH claim: the face is NOT excluded by these results. What lands today is (i) the repaired+verified streaming machinery, (ii) the calibrated counting mechanism (B ~= 0 in known territory), (iii) the quantitative certificate that the plain xi-kernel known field is the wrong lever at face height (negative margin, failing bound validity), and (iv) the named next step 0273b with the R-vM top-edge bound.
